title: Daniel 7 — The night vision of the four beasts, the Ancient of Days, and one like a son of man

translation.sourceText: Daniel — per-verse layered-witness reconstruction (Masoretic Text Aramaic per BHS Codex Leningradensis primary; DSS 4Q112-4Q113 secondary; Old Greek + Theodotion-Greek tertiary, especially at v 13 where OG ἐπί and Th μετά diverge — Theodotion conforms more closely to MT עִם). Chapter 7 entirely Aramaic; the last Aramaic chapter; ch 8 returns to Hebrew. Structural climax of the chiastic Aramaic core (chs 2-7), pairing with ch 2.

paragraphs.text: בִּשְׁנַ֣ת חֲדָ֗ה לְבֵלְאשַׁצַּר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל דָּנִיֵּאל֙ חֵ֣לֶם חֲזָ֔ה וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשֵׁ֖הּ עַֽל־מִשְׁכְּבֵ֑הּ בֵּאדַ֙יִן֙ חֶלְמָ֣א כְתַ֔ב רֵ֥אשׁ מִלִּ֖ין אֲמַֽר׃
paragraphs.translit: bi-šnaṯ ḥăḏāh lə-Bēlšaʾṣṣar meleḵ Bāḇel Dāniyyēʾl ḥēlem ḥăzāh wə-ḥezwê rēšēh ʿal-miškəḇēh bēʾḏayin ḥelmāʾ ḵəṯaḇ rēʾš millîn ʾămar

i18n.en: In the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, Daniel had a dream and visions of his head upon his bed; then he wrote the dream and told the sum of the matters.

paragraphs.text: עָנֵ֤ה דָנִיֵּאל֙ וְאָמַ֔ר חָזֵ֥ה הֲוֵ֛ית בְּחֶזְוִ֖י עִם־לֵֽילְיָ֑א וַאֲר֗וּ אַרְבַּע֙ רוּחֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א מְגִיחָ֖ן לְיַמָּ֥א רַבָּֽא׃
paragraphs.translit: ʿănēh Dāniyyēʾl wə-ʾāmar ḥāzēh hăwêṯ bə-ḥezwî ʿim-lêləyāʾ wa-ʾărū ʾarbaʿ rūḥê šəmayyāʾ məḡîḥān lə-yammāʾ rabbāʾ

i18n.en: Daniel spoke and said, "I saw in my vision by night, and behold, the four winds of heaven broke forth upon the great sea.

paragraphs.text: וְאַרְבַּ֤ע חֵיוָן֙ רַבְרְבָ֔ן סָלְקָ֖ן מִן־יַמָּ֑א שָׁנְיָ֖ן דָּ֥א מִן־דָּֽא׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʾarbaʿ ḥêwān raḇrəḇān sāləqān min-yammāʾ šānyān dāʾ min-dāʾ

i18n.en: And four great beasts came up from the sea, different one from another.

paragraphs.text: קַדְמָיְתָ֣א כְאַרְיֵ֔ה וְגַפִּ֥ין דִּֽי־נְשַׁ֖ר לַ֑הּ חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּי־מְרִ֨יטוּ גַפַּ֜יהּ וּנְטִ֣ילַת מִן־אַרְעָ֗א וְעַל־רַגְלַ֙יִן֙ כֶּאֱנָ֣שׁ הֳקִימַ֔ת וּלְבַ֥ב אֱנָ֖שׁ יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃
paragraphs.translit: qaḏmāyəṯāʾ ḵə-ʾaryēh wə-gappîn dî-nəšar lah ḥāzēh hăwêṯ ʿaḏ dî-mərîṭū ḡappayh ū-nəṭîlaṯ min-ʾarʿāʾ wə-ʿal-raḡlayin ke-ʾĕnāš hŏqîmaṯ ū-ləḇaḇ ʾĕnāš yəhîḇ lah

i18n.en: The first was like a lion, and had eagle's wings. I beheld until its wings were plucked, and it was lifted up from the earth, and made to stand upon two feet as a man; and a man's heart was given to it.

paragraphs.text: וַאֲר֣וּ חֵיוָה֩ אָחֳרִ֨י תִנְיָנָ֜ה דָּמְיָ֣ה לְדֹ֗ב וְלִשְׂטַר־חַד֙ הֳקִמַ֔ת וּתְלָ֥ת עִלְעִ֛ין בְּפֻמַּ֖הּ בֵּ֣ין שניה שִׁנַּ֑יהּ וְכֵן֙ אָמְרִ֣ין לַ֔הּ ק֥וּמִֽי אֲכֻ֖לִי בְּשַׂ֥ר שַׂגִּֽיא׃
paragraphs.translit: wa-ʾărū ḥêwāh ʾoḥŏrî ṯinyānāh dāməyāh lə-ḏōḇ wə-li-śṭar-ḥaḏ hŏqimaṯ ū-ṯəlāṯ ʿilʿîn bə-p̄ummah bên šinnayh wə-ḵēn ʾāmərîn lah qūmî ʾăḵulî bəśar śaggîʾ

i18n.en: And behold, another beast, a second, like a bear; and it was raised up on one side, and three ribs were in its mouth between its teeth; and they said thus to it, "Arise, devour much flesh."

paragraphs.text: בָּאתַ֨ר דְּנָ֜ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית וַאֲר֤וּ אָֽחֳרִי֙ כִּנְמַ֔ר וְלַ֨הּ גַּפִּ֥ין אַרְבַּ֛ע דִּי־ע֖וֹף עַל־גביה גַּבַּ֑יהּ וְאַרְבְּעָ֤ה רֵאשִׁין֙ לְחֵ֣יוְתָ֔א וְשָׁלְטָ֖ן יְהִ֥יב לַֽהּ׃
paragraphs.translit: bāʾṯar dənāh ḥāzēh hăwêṯ wa-ʾărū ʾoḥŏrî ki-nmar wə-lah gappîn ʾarbaʿ dî-ʿōp̄ ʿal-gabbayh wə-ʾarbəʿāh rēšîn lə-ḥêwəṯāʾ wə-šolṭān yəhîḇ lah

i18n.en: After this I beheld, and lo, another, like a leopard, which had upon its back four wings of a bird; the beast had also four heads; and dominion was given to it.

paragraphs.text: בָּאתַ֣ר דְּנָה֩ חָזֵ֨ה הֲוֵ֜ית בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֗א וַאֲר֣וּ ׀ חֵיוָ֣ה רביעיה רְֽבִיעָאָ֡ה דְּחִילָה֩ וְאֵֽימְתָנִ֨י וְתַקִּיפָ֜א יַתִּ֗ירָה וְשִׁנַּ֤יִן דִּֽי־פַרְזֶל֙ לַ֣הּ רַבְרְבָ֔ן אָֽכְלָ֣ה וּמַדֱּקָ֔ה וּשְׁאָרָ֖א ברגליה בְּרַגְלַ֣הּ רָפְסָ֑ה וְהִ֣יא מְשַׁנְּיָ֗ה מִן־כָּל־חֵֽיוָתָא֙ דִּ֣י קָֽדָמַ֔יהּ וְקַרְנַ֥יִן עֲשַׂ֖ר לַֽהּ׃
paragraphs.translit: bāʾṯar dənāh ḥāzēh hăwêṯ bə-ḥezwê lêləyāʾ wa-ʾărū ḥêwāh rəḇîʿāʾāh dəḥîlāh wə-ʾêməṯānî wə-ṯaqqîpāʾ yattîrāh wə-šinnayin dî-p̄arzel lah raḇrəḇān ʾāḵəlāh ū-maddĕqāh ū-šəʾārāʾ bə-raḡlah rāp̄əsāh wə-hîʾ məšannəyāh min-kol-ḥêwāṯāʾ dī qodāmayh wə-qarnayin ʿăśar lah

i18n.en: After this I saw in the night visions, and behold, a fourth beast, terrible and powerful, and strong exceedingly; and it had great iron teeth; it devoured and broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet; and it was different from all the beasts that were before it; and it had ten horns.

paragraphs.text: מִשְׂתַּכַּ֨ל הֲוֵ֜ית בְּקַרְנַיָּ֗א וַ֠אֲלוּ קֶ֣רֶן אָחֳרִ֤י זְעֵירָה֙ סִלְקָ֣ת ביניהון בֵּֽינֵיהֵ֔ן וּתְלָ֗ת מִן־קַרְנַיָּא֙ קַדְמָ֣יָתָ֔א אתעקרו אֶתְעֲקַ֖רָה מִן־קדמיה קֳדָמַ֑הּ וַאֲל֨וּ עַיְנִ֜ין כְּעַיְנֵ֤י אֲנָשָׁא֙ בְּקַרְנָא־דָ֔א וּפֻ֖ם מְמַלִּ֥ל רַבְרְבָֽן׃
paragraphs.translit: miśtakkal hăwêṯ bə-qarnayyāʾ wa-ʾălū qeren ʾoḥŏrî zəʿêrāh siləqāṯ bênêhēn ū-ṯəlāṯ min-qarnayyāʾ qaḏmāyāṯāʾ ʾeṯʿăqarāh min-qodāmah wa-ʾălū ʿaynîn kə-ʿaynê ʾănāšāʾ bə-qarnāʾ-ḏāʾ ū-p̄um məmallil raḇrəḇān

i18n.en: I considered the horns, and behold, there came up among them another horn, a little one, before which three of the first horns were plucked up by the roots; and behold, in this horn were eyes like the eyes of a man, and a mouth speaking great things.

paragraphs.text: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֗ית עַ֣ד דִּ֤י כָרְסָוָן֙ רְמִ֔יו וְעַתִּ֥יק יוֹמִ֖ין יְתִ֑ב לְבוּשֵׁ֣הּ ׀ כִּתְלַ֣ג חִוָּ֗ר וּשְׂעַ֤ר רֵאשֵׁהּ֙ כַּעֲמַ֣ר נְקֵ֔א כָּרְסְיֵהּ֙ שְׁבִיבִ֣ין דִּי־נ֔וּר גַּלְגִּלּ֖וֹהִי נ֥וּר דָּלִֽק׃
paragraphs.translit: ḥāzēh hăwêṯ ʿaḏ dī ḵorsāwān rəmîw wə-ʿattîq yōmîn yəṯiḇ ləḇūšēh ki-ṯlaḡ ḥiwwār ū-śəʿar rēšēh ka-ʿămar nəqēʾ korsəyēh šəḇîḇîn dî-nūr galgillōhî nūr dāliq

i18n.en: I beheld till thrones were placed, and one that was Ancient of Days did sit: his raiment was white as snow, and the hair of his head like pure wool; his throne was fiery flames, and the wheels thereof burning fire.

notes.official: **THE THRONE-VISION** — the load-bearing center of the Second Temple Jewish + early Christian throne-vision tradition. The Ancient of Days (Aramaic *ʿAttiq Yomin*) seated on a throne of flames + the river of fire issuing + the THOUSAND THOUSANDS attending + the books opened. Foundational cross-corpus to Ezek 1:26-28 + 1 En 14:18-23 + Rev 5:11 + Rev 20:12 + Shi'ur Qomah cosmic-body-of-divine. **This completes the four-tradition throne-vision wire on the translation surface** (the wire previously existed only in glossary apparatus until Daniel was translated). The white-hair-as-wool iconography is transferred to the risen Christ at Rev 1:14 — one of the most direct verbal-borrowings in the NT from the Aramaic HB.

paragraphs.text: נְהַ֣ר דִּי־נ֗וּר נָגֵ֤ד וְנָפֵק֙ מִן־קֳדָמ֔וֹהִי אֶ֤לֶף אלפים אַלְפִין֙ יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵּ֔הּ וְרִבּ֥וֹ רבון רִבְבָ֖ן קָֽדָמ֣וֹהִי יְקוּמ֑וּן דִּינָ֥א יְתִ֖ב וְסִפְרִ֥ין פְּתִֽיחוּ׃
paragraphs.translit: nəhar dî-nūr nāḡēḏ wə-nāp̄ēq min-qodāmōhî ʾelep̄ ʾalpîn yəšamməšūnnēh wə-ribbō riḇḇān qodāmōhî yəqūmūn dînāʾ yəṯiḇ wə-sip̄rîn pəṯîḥū

i18n.en: A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered to him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.

notes.official: **THOUSAND THOUSANDS + TEN THOUSAND TIMES TEN THOUSAND** + **BOOKS OPENED**. Cross-corpus: Rev 5:11 verbatim ('I heard the voice of many angels around the throne... thousand thousands' / Greek *chiliades chiliadōn*); Rev 20:12 ('and the books were opened'); 1 En 14:19 (the river of fire); Jub 5:13 + the heavenly-tablets cluster. The thousand-thousands + ten-thousand-myriads is a typical apocalyptic intensification.

paragraphs.text: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית בֵּאדַ֗יִן מִן־קָל֙ מִלַּיָּ֣א רַבְרְבָתָ֔א דִּ֥י קַרְנָ֖א מְמַלֱּלָ֑ה חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֡ית עַד֩ דִּ֨י קְטִילַ֤ת חֵֽיוְתָא֙ וְהוּבַ֣ד גִּשְׁמַ֔הּ וִיהִיבַ֖ת לִיקֵדַ֥ת אֶשָּֽׁא׃
paragraphs.translit: ḥāzēh hăwêṯ bēʾḏayin min-qāl millayyāʾ raḇrəḇāṯāʾ dī qarnāʾ məmallĕlāh ḥāzēh hăwêṯ ʿaḏ dī qəṭîlaṯ ḥêwəṯāʾ wə-hūḇaḏ gišmah wî-hîḇaṯ lî-qêḏaṯ ʾeššāʾ

i18n.en: I beheld at that time because of the voice of the great words which the horn spoke; I beheld even till the beast was slain, and its body destroyed, and it was given to be burned with fire.

paragraphs.text: וּשְׁאָר֙ חֵֽיוָתָ֔א הֶעְדִּ֖יו שָׁלְטָנְה֑וֹן וְאַרְכָ֧ה בְחַיִּ֛ין יְהִ֥יבַת לְה֖וֹן עַד־זְמַ֥ן וְעִדָּֽן׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-šəʾār ḥêwāṯāʾ heʿdîw šolṭānə-hōn wə-ʾarḵāh ḇə-ḥayyîn yəhîḇaṯ lə-hōn ʿaḏ-zəman wə-ʿiddān

i18n.en: And as for the rest of the beasts, their dominion was taken away; yet their lives were prolonged for a season and a time.

paragraphs.text: חָזֵ֤ה הֲוֵית֙ בְּחֶזְוֵ֣י לֵֽילְיָ֔א וַאֲרוּ֙ עִם־עֲנָנֵ֣י שְׁמַיָּ֔א כְּבַ֥ר אֱנָ֖שׁ אָתֵ֣ה הֲוָ֑ה וְעַד־עַתִּ֤יק יֽוֹמַיָּא֙ מְטָ֔ה וּקְדָמ֖וֹהִי הַקְרְבֽוּהִי׃
paragraphs.translit: ḥāzēh hăwêṯ bə-ḥezwê lêləyāʾ wa-ʾărū ʿim-ʿănānê šəmayyāʾ kə-ḇar ʾĕnāš ʾāṯēh hăwāh wə-ʿaḏ-ʿattîq yōmayyāʾ məṭāh ū-qədāmōhî haqrəḇūhî

i18n.en: I saw in the night visions, and behold, there came with the clouds of heaven one like a son of man, and he came even to the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before him.

notes.official: **ONE LIKE A SON OF MAN** (Aramaic *kə-bar ʾĕnāš*) coming with clouds-of-heaven + brought before the Ancient of Days. **THE MOST-LOAD-BEARING CHRISTOLOGICAL TEXT IN THE HEBREW BIBLE/ARAMAIC CORPUS**. NT inheritance: Mark 14:62 (Jesus' self-identification at the trial); Mt 26:64 (parallel); Rev 1:7 (he comes with clouds); Rev 1:13 + 14:14 (Christological-iconography transfer); Acts 7:55-56 (Stephen's vision). 1 En Similitudes (46-48 + 71) develops the parallel pre-existent-Son-of-Man tradition. 4 Ezra 13 develops the man-from-the-sea figure. Scholarly debate (Collins 1993 corporate-saints reading vs Casey 1979 generic-human-being vs individual-messianic reading) preserved without doctrinal resolution.

paragraphs.text: וְלֵ֨הּ יְהִ֤יב שָׁלְטָן֙ וִיקָ֣ר וּמַלְכ֔וּ וְכֹ֣ל עַֽמְמַיָּ֗א אֻמַיָּ֛א וְלִשָּׁנַיָּ֖א לֵ֣הּ יִפְלְח֑וּן שָׁלְטָנֵ֞הּ שָׁלְטָ֤ן עָלַם֙ דִּֽי־לָ֣א יֶעְדֵּ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתֵ֖הּ דִּי־לָ֥א תִתְחַבַּֽל׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-lēh yəhîḇ šolṭān wî-qār ū-malḵū wə-ḵōl ʿammə-mayyāʾ ʾummayyāʾ wə-liššānayyāʾ lēh yip̄ləḥūn šolṭānēh šolṭān ʿālam dî-lāʾ yeʿdēh ū-malḵūṯēh dî-lāʾ ṯiṯḥabbal

i18n.en: And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom, that all the peoples, nations, and languages should serve him: his dominion is an everlasting dominion, which shall not pass away, and his kingdom that which shall not be destroyed.

notes.official: Universal dominion + all peoples + nations + languages serving + eternal dominion that will not pass away. Cross-corpus to Mt 28:18 (Jesus' Great Commission claim of 'all authority in heaven and on earth'). The 'kingdom that shall not be destroyed' parallels Dan 2:44 stone-kingdom.

paragraphs.text: אֶתְכְּרִיַּ֥ת רוּחִ֛י אֲנָ֥ה דָנִיֵּ֖אל בְּג֣וֹא נִדְנֶ֑ה וְחֶזְוֵ֥י רֵאשִׁ֖י יְבַהֲלֻנַּֽנִי׃
paragraphs.translit: ʾeṯkəriyyaṯ rūḥî ʾănāh Dāniyyēʾl bə-ḡōʾ niḏneh wə-ḥezwê rēšî yəḇahălunnannî

i18n.en: As for me, Daniel, my spirit was grieved in the midst of my body, and the visions of my head troubled me.

paragraphs.text: קִרְבֵ֗ת עַל־חַד֙ מִן־קָ֣אֲמַיָּ֔א וְיַצִּיבָ֥א אֶבְעֵֽא־מִנֵּ֖הּ עַֽל־כָּל־דְּנָ֑ה וַאֲמַר־לִ֕י וּפְשַׁ֥ר מִלַּיָּ֖א יְהוֹדְעִנַּֽנִי׃
paragraphs.translit: qirḇēṯ ʿal-ḥaḏ min-qāʾămayyāʾ wə-yaṣṣîḇāʾ ʾeḇʿēʾ-minnēh ʿal-kol-dənāh wa-ʾămar-lî ū-p̄əšar millayyāʾ yə-hōḏəʿinnannî

i18n.en: I came near to one of them that stood by, and asked him the truth concerning all this. So he told me, and made me know the interpretation of the things.

paragraphs.text: אִלֵּין֙ חֵיוָתָ֣א רַבְרְבָתָ֔א דִּ֥י אִנִּ֖ין אַרְבַּ֑ע אַרְבְּעָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקוּמ֥וּן מִן־אַרְעָֽא׃
paragraphs.translit: ʾillên ḥêwāṯāʾ raḇrəḇāṯāʾ dī ʾinnîn ʾarbaʿ ʾarbəʿāh malḵîn yəqūmūn min-ʾarʿāʾ

i18n.en: These great beasts, which are four, are four kings, that shall arise out of the earth.

paragraphs.text: וִֽיקַבְּלוּן֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔א קַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְיַחְסְנ֤וּן מַלְכוּתָא֙ עַֽד־עָ֣לְמָ֔א וְעַ֖ד עָלַ֥ם עָלְמַיָּֽא׃
paragraphs.translit: wî-qabbəlūn malḵūṯāʾ qaddîšê ʿelyōnîn wə-yaḥsənūn malḵūṯāʾ ʿaḏ-ʿāləmāʾ wə-ʿaḏ ʿālam ʿāləmayyāʾ

i18n.en: But the holy ones of the Most High shall receive the kingdom, and possess the kingdom for ever, even for ever and ever.

paragraphs.text: אֱדַ֗יִן צְבִית֙ לְיַצָּבָ֔א עַל־חֵֽיוְתָא֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔א דִּֽי־הֲוָ֥ת שָֽׁנְיָ֖ה מִן־כלהון כָּלְּהֵ֑ין דְּחִילָ֣ה יַתִּ֗ירָה שניה שִׁנַּ֤הּ דִּֽי־פַרְזֶל֙ וטפריה וְטִפְרַ֣הּ דִּֽי־נְחָ֔שׁ אָֽכְלָ֣ה מַדֱּקָ֔ה וּשְׁאָרָ֖א בְּרַגְלַ֥הּ רָֽפְסָֽה׃
paragraphs.translit: ʾĕdayin ṣəḇîṯ lə-yaṣṣāḇāʾ ʿal-ḥêwəṯāʾ rəḇîʿāyəṯāʾ dî-hăwāṯ šānyāh min-kolləhên dəḥîlāh yattîrāh šinnah dî-p̄arzel wə-ṭiprah dî-nəḥāš ʾāḵəlāh maddĕqāh ū-šəʾārāʾ bə-raḡlah rāp̄əsāh

i18n.en: Then I desired to know the truth concerning the fourth beast, which was different from all of them, exceedingly terrible, whose teeth were of iron, and its nails of bronze; which devoured, broke in pieces, and stamped the residue with its feet;

paragraphs.text: וְעַל־קַרְנַיָּ֤א עֲשַׂר֙ דִּ֣י בְרֵאשַׁ֔הּ וְאָחֳרִי֙ דִּ֣י סִלְקַ֔ת ונפלו וּנְפַ֥לָה מִן־קדמיה קֳדָמַ֖הּ תְּלָ֑ת וְקַרְנָ֨א דִכֵּ֜ן וְעַיְנִ֣ין לַ֗הּ וְפֻם֙ מְמַלִּ֣ל רַבְרְבָ֔ן וְחֶזְוַ֖הּ רַ֥ב מִן־חַבְרָתַֽהּ׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ʿal-qarnayyāʾ ʿăśar dī ḇə-rēšah wə-ʾoḥŏrî dī siləqaṯ ū-nəp̄alāh min-qodāmah təlāṯ wə-qarnāʾ ḏikkēn wə-ʿaynîn lah wə-p̄um məmallil raḇrəḇān wə-ḥezwah raḇ min-ḥaḇrāṯah

i18n.en: and concerning the ten horns that were on its head, and the other which came up, and before which three fell; even that horn that had eyes, and a mouth that spoke great things, whose look was more stout than its fellows.

paragraphs.text: חָזֵ֣ה הֲוֵ֔ית וְקַרְנָ֣א דִכֵּ֔ן עָבְדָ֥ה קְרָ֖ב עִם־קַדִּישִׁ֑ין וְיָכְלָ֖ה לְהֽוֹן׃
paragraphs.translit: ḥāzēh hăwêṯ wə-qarnāʾ ḏikkēn ʿāḇəḏāh qərāḇ ʿim-qaddîšîn wə-yāḵəlāh lə-hōn

i18n.en: I beheld, and the same horn made war with the holy ones, and prevailed against them;

paragraphs.text: עַ֣ד דִּֽי־אֲתָ֗ה עַתִּיק֙ יֽוֹמַיָּ֔א וְדִינָ֣א יְהִ֔ב לְקַדִּישֵׁ֖י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין וְזִמְנָ֣א מְטָ֔ה וּמַלְכוּתָ֖א הֶחֱסִ֥נוּ קַדִּישִֽׁין׃
paragraphs.translit: ʿaḏ dî-ʾăṯāh ʿattîq yōmayyāʾ wə-ḏînāʾ yəhiḇ lə-qaddîšê ʿelyōnîn wə-zimnāʾ məṭāh ū-malḵūṯāʾ heḥĕsinū qaddîšîn

i18n.en: until the Ancient of Days came, and judgment was given to the holy ones of the Most High, and the time came that the holy ones possessed the kingdom.

paragraphs.text: כֵּן֮ אֲמַר֒ חֵֽיוְתָא֙ רְבִיעָ֣יְתָ֔א מַלְכ֤וּ רביעיא רְבִיעָאָה֙ תֶּהֱוֵ֣א בְאַרְעָ֔א דִּ֥י תִשְׁנֵ֖א מִן־כָּל־מַלְכְוָתָ֑א וְתֵאכֻל֙ כָּל־אַרְעָ֔א וּתְדוּשִׁנַּ֖הּ וְתַדְּקִנַּֽהּ׃
paragraphs.translit: kēn ʾămar ḥêwəṯāʾ rəḇîʿāyəṯāʾ malḵū rəḇîʿāʾāh tehĕwēʾ ḇə-ʾarʿāʾ dī ṯišnēʾ min-kol-malḵəwāṯāʾ wə-ṯêḵul kol-ʾarʿāʾ ū-ṯəḏūšinnah wə-ṯaddəqinnah

i18n.en: Thus he said, "The fourth beast shall be a fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be different from all the kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth, and shall tread it down, and break it in pieces.

paragraphs.text: וְקַרְנַיָּ֣א עֲשַׂ֔ר מִנַּהּ֙ מַלְכוּתָ֔ה עַשְׂרָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְקֻמ֑וּן וְאָחֳרָ֞ן יְק֣וּם אַחֲרֵיה֗וֹן וְה֤וּא יִשְׁנֵא֙ מִן־קַדְמָיֵ֔א וּתְלָתָ֥ה מַלְכִ֖ין יְהַשְׁפִּֽל׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-qarnayyāʾ ʿăśar minnah malḵūṯāh ʿaśrāh malḵîn yəqumūn wə-ʾoḥŏrān yəqūm ʾaḥărêhōn wə-hūʾ yišnēʾ min-qaḏmāyēʾ ū-ṯəlāṯāh malḵîn yəhašpil

i18n.en: And as for the ten horns, out of this kingdom shall ten kings arise; and another shall arise after them; and he shall be different from the former, and he shall put down three kings.

paragraphs.text: וּמִלִּ֗ין לְצַ֤ד עליא עִלָּאָה֙ יְמַלִּ֔ל וּלְקַדִּישֵׁ֥י עֶלְיוֹנִ֖ין יְבַלֵּ֑א וְיִסְבַּ֗ר לְהַשְׁנָיָה֙ זִמְנִ֣ין וְדָ֔ת וְיִתְיַהֲב֣וּן בִּידֵ֔הּ עַד־עִדָּ֥ן וְעִדָּנִ֖ין וּפְלַ֥ג עִדָּֽן׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-millîn lə-ṣaḏ ʿillāʾāh yəmallil ū-lə-qaddîšê ʿelyōnîn yəḇallēʾ wə-yisbar lə-hašnāyāh zimnîn wə-ḏāṯ wə-yiṯyahăḇūn bî-ḏēh ʿaḏ-ʿiddān wə-ʿiddānîn ū-p̄əlaḡ ʿiddān

i18n.en: And he shall speak words against the Most High, and shall wear out the holy ones of the Most High; and he shall think to change the times and the law; and they shall be given into his hand for a time, and times, and half a time.

notes.official: **TIME, TIMES, AND HALF A TIME** (Aramaic *ʿiddān wə-ʿiddānīn ū-pəlag ʿiddān*). The 3.5-times calendrical-arithmetic. Cross-corpus to Rev 11:2-3 (1260 days = 42 months = 3.5 years) + Rev 12:6 + Rev 12:14 + Rev 13:5. The Maccabean-period referent is the Antiochene persecution period (167-164 BCE) per Collins 1993; the apocalyptic-time-symbolism inheritance extends to the NT eschatology + dispensationalist tradition.

paragraphs.text: וְדִינָ֖א יִתִּ֑ב וְשָׁלְטָנֵ֣הּ יְהַעְדּ֔וֹן לְהַשְׁמָדָ֥ה וּלְהוֹבָדָ֖ה עַד־סוֹפָֽא׃
paragraphs.translit: wə-ḏînāʾ yittiḇ wə-šolṭānēh yəhaʿdōn lə-hašmāḏāh ū-lə-hōḇāḏāh ʿaḏ-sōp̄āʾ

i18n.en: But the judgment shall be set, and they shall take away his dominion, to consume and to destroy it to the end.

paragraphs.text: וּמַלְכוּתָ֨ה וְשָׁלְטָנָ֜א וּרְבוּתָ֗א דִּ֚י מַלְכְוָת֙ תְּח֣וֹת כָּל־שְׁמַיָּ֔א יְהִיבַ֕ת לְעַ֖ם קַדִּישֵׁ֣י עֶלְיוֹנִ֑ין מַלְכוּתֵהּ֙ מַלְכ֣וּת עָלַ֔ם וְכֹל֙ שָׁלְטָ֣נַיָּ֔א לֵ֥הּ יִפְלְח֖וּן וְיִֽשְׁתַּמְּעֽוּן׃
paragraphs.translit: ū-malḵūṯāh wə-šolṭānāʾ ū-rəḇūṯāʾ dī malḵəwāṯ təḥōṯ kol-šəmayyāʾ yəhîḇaṯ lə-ʿam qaddîšê ʿelyōnîn malḵūṯēh malḵūṯ ʿālam wə-ḵōl šolṭānayyāʾ lēh yip̄ləḥūn wə-yištamməʿūn

i18n.en: And the kingdom and the dominion, and the greatness of the kingdoms under the whole heaven, shall be given to the people of the holy ones of the Most High: his kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions shall serve and obey him."

paragraphs.text: עַד־כָּ֖ה סוֹפָ֣א דִֽי־מִלְּתָ֑א אֲנָ֨ה דָֽנִיֵּ֜אל שַׂגִּ֣יא ׀ רַעְיוֹנַ֣י יְבַהֲלֻנַּ֗נִי וְזִיוַי֙ יִשְׁתַּנּ֣וֹן עֲלַ֔י וּמִלְּתָ֖א בְּלִבִּ֥י נִטְרֵֽת׃
paragraphs.translit: ʿaḏ-kāh sōp̄āʾ ḏî-milləṯāʾ ʾănāh Dāniyyēʾl śaggîʾ raʿyōnay yəḇahălunnannî wə-zîway yištannōn ʿălay ū-milləṯāʾ bə-libbî niṭrēṯ

i18n.en: Here is the end of the matter. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts much troubled me, and my countenance was changed in me; but I kept the matter in my heart.
